QuestInfo.name: [Guild Castle] Grader, the Vortex of Greed
QuestInfo.0:
St. Tia...
Grader said the name of the ruined land was St Tia.
What's his history with this place?
QuestInfo.1:
#r"Kneel before me and accept the grace bestowed upon you," said the dragon#k

Jack had told you the dragon could be dangerously persuasive. Defying the creature, you clenched your fists and stared back up at him. His glaring eyes filled your field of vision.
QuestInfo.2:
Grader claims he's in the right, and that you, a stranger to this castle, have no way of knowing who's right or wrong.

He has a point, but you believe the sincerity in Jack and Benedict's eyes.
